description: Phase-47 RESEARCH-ONLY dataflow-aware demotion gate for omitted_term / computed_unapplied candidates. Read ONLY by scripts/omitted_term_dataflow_gate.py (un-wired). Runs AFTER the P45 mechanism_advancement_gate, on candidates whose pre-decision is ADVANCE/REVIEW_ONLY and whose mechanism is omitted_term or computed_unapplied. It can ONLY demote (ADVANCE->REVIEW_ONLY/ABSTAIN, REVIEW_ONLY->ABSTAIN) and never promotes. A computed term is APPLIED (so the omitted/computed candidate is demoted) when it flows, via >=1 intermediate derived variable or a source-visible internal callee, into a value/state/authority sink. Direct in-arg appearance is NOT treated here as newly-applied (the prior gate already evaluates it). Generic only — NO subject identifiers. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].
